categories.main_business_segments: TopBuild operates in two main business segments: Installation and Specialty Distribution. The Installation segment provides insulation installation services and other building products, while the Specialty Distribution segment distributes insulation, insulation accessories, and other building materials to contractors and dealers. Installation accounted for approximately 59% of 2022 sales, and Specialty Distribution for 41%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: TopBuild's core methods include professional installation of various insulation types (fiberglass batts and rolls, blown-in fiberglass and cellulose, spray foam) and distribution of building materials. The company manages the full installation process, from material procurement to quality assurance, and leverages building science expertise through its Environments for Living program. Specialty Distribution relies on efficient logistics and value-added fabrication services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves national and regional homebuilders, custom and multi-family builders, commercial/industrial general contractors, remodelers, and individual homeowners through its Installation segment. Specialty Distribution customers include insulation contractors, gutter and weatherization contractors, dealers, metal building erectors, and modular home builders, addressing both residential and commercial/industrial end markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: TopBuild operates primarily in the United States, with approximately 230 Installation branches and 162 Specialty Distribution centers across the U.S., plus 17 distribution centers in Canada. Its broad geographic footprint enables it to serve customers nationwide and in select Canadian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: TopBuild operates both downstream as an installer of building products and midstream as a specialty distributor of insulation and related materials. This dual position allows the company to reach a wide range of customers and manage supply chain efficiencies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on growth and productivity, including expanding market share in residential and commercial/industrial end markets, acquiring strategically aligned businesses, leveraging technology to streamline processes, and driving operational efficiencies. TopBuild emphasizes innovation in building science, safety, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on talent attraction and retention.
categories.revenue_model: TopBuild generates revenue primarily through installation services (recognized over time as performance obligations are satisfied) and product sales through its distribution centers (recognized at the point of sale). Revenue streams are diversified across residential and commercial/industrial markets, with additional value-added services such as energy efficiency consulting.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a highly fragmented and competitive market, facing national, regional, and local contractors, specialty insulation distributors, broad-line building products distributors, big box retailers, and insulation manufacturers. TopBuild is a market leader in both installation and specialty distribution, leveraging its scale, geographic reach, and local presence to maintain a strong competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, TopBuild reported net sales of $5.0 billion, a 43.7% increase over 2021, driven by acquisitions, higher selling prices, and increased sales volume. Net income was $556 million, with strong operating and net margins. The company has demonstrated significant growth through both organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, supported by robust cash flow and liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TopBuild differentiates itself through its dual business model, combining installation and specialty distribution, which provides supply chain efficiencies, broad customer reach, and resilience to market cycles. Its scale, local market presence, expertise in building science, and commitment to safety and quality deliver consistent, high-value service to customers, while its ability to offer both products and installation services enhances its competitive advantage.
